dedupe_keys.name: bande de dup du canal seine nord europe

description: Bande de DUP du canal Seine-Nord Europe is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The Seine-Nord Europe link is a project to link the port of Le Havre in the Benelux with a new large-scale canal. For this, this 106 km canal must connect the Oise (in Compiègne in the Oise) to the Dunkerque-Escaut canal (in Aubencheul-au-Bac, in the North). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "DUP strip of the Seine-Nord Canal Europe" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
